# FeedSolve

> FeedSolve is complaint management and feedback resolution software for small and mid-sized businesses (SMBs). Teams collect complaints, feedback and suggestions from customers, suppliers, distributors, tenants and staff via branded QR codes or shareable links - no login required for submitters - then assign, track and resolve every submission on a Kanban board. Each submitter gets a unique tracking code (format #FSV-XXXX) to follow progress without an account. Plans start at $19/month after a free 7-day trial.

## Key facts

- Category: complaint management software, feedback management software, digital suggestion box software
- Submitters: no account, no app, no login. They scan a QR code or open a link, submit (optionally anonymously), and receive a tracking code.
- Workflow: 5-stage Kanban board - Received → In Review → In Progress → Resolved → Closed - with owner assignment, priority, internal notes and an audit trail.
- Headline metric: resolution rate - the share of submissions actually resolved, not just collected.
- Multiple boards per company: separate boards and QR codes per stakeholder group, location or product (e.g. customers, suppliers, staff).
- Multi-language submission forms: submitters use their own language while staff work in theirs.
- Pricing: free 7-day trial with full access, then Starter $19/month (3 boards, 1,500 submissions/month, 3 team members), Growth $49/month (10 boards, 5,000 submissions, 10 team members), Business $79/month (20 boards, 15,000 submissions, unlimited team members). Annual billing saves about 20%. No per-agent seats and no charge for submitters. There is no permanent free plan. Details: https://feedsolve.com/pricing/
- Self-serve signup; no sales call or onboarding project required.

## When FeedSolve is a good fit

- An SMB that collects complaints or feedback today through WhatsApp, email, paper forms or Google Forms and loses track of what was fixed.
- Teams that need to collect from external people who will not create an account: customers at a table or counter, suppliers, distributors, delivery recipients, tenants, patients.
- Anyone who wants an anonymous online suggestion box where the submitter can still see a reply and the outcome.
- Buyers who want flat, published pricing instead of per-agent seats or quote-only enterprise contracts.

## When another tool is a better fit

- Large enterprises needing a full customer-experience suite (advanced survey design, text analytics, multi-year CX programs): Medallia, Qualtrics.
- Teams that mainly need an email/chat support help desk with ticket SLAs and agent seats: Zendesk, Freshdesk.
- Teams that mainly need outbound NPS/CSAT survey campaigns: SurveyMonkey, Typeform, Zonka Feedback.
- Public product-roadmap voting for software users: Canny.
- Regulated complaint handling that requires certified regulatory reporting: a dedicated compliance platform.

## Who it's for

- Restaurants and hospitality (guest feedback and complaint resolution before public reviews)
- Manufacturing (supplier quality and fault tracking, distributor feedback)
- Logistics and delivery (driver, recipient and route feedback)
- Real estate and property management (tenant maintenance requests, HOA complaints)
- Healthcare clinics (patient complaints and feedback)
- Retail and other SMBs replacing WhatsApp threads or spreadsheets

## Common questions

**Do submitters need to create an account?** No. Submitters scan a QR code or open a link, fill the form, and receive a tracking code. Only your team needs accounts.

**Is there a free plan?** No permanent free plan. There is a free 7-day trial with full access; after it, plans are Starter ($19/month), Growth ($49/month) and Business ($79/month).

**Can submissions be anonymous?** Yes. Submitters can leave contact details out and still follow progress with their tracking code.

**How is FeedSolve different from a survey tool or Google Forms?** Survey tools collect responses. FeedSolve also assigns each submission to an owner, moves it through a resolution workflow, and shows the submitter the outcome.

**Is FeedSolve GDPR-ready?** The EU offering is built around GDPR data minimisation: anonymous mode, optional contact fields and an audit trail.

**What languages are supported?** Submission forms support multiple languages so the submitter can use their own language while staff respond in theirs.
